plugins.name: voxflow
plugins.description: AI voice CLI bundled as 5 skills. TTS in 200+ voices across 40+ languages, multi-speaker AI podcasts, audio/video transcription with word-level timestamps, SRT-driven dubbing, end-to-end video translation, and long-article → vertical card video reels via Remotion. Backed by a hosted TTS/ASR/LLM/render service with per-user quota (free tier 10K/mo).
